policies.title: GP access guarantee
policies.statement: Guarantee everyone the right to see a GP within one week, or within 24 hours if the need is urgent.

policies.title: Free personal care
policies.statement: Introduce free personal care for older and disabled people in their own homes, funded by reversing tax cuts to major banks.

policies.title: End A&E 12-hour waits
policies.statement: Put a legal duty on the Health Secretary to end 12-hour waits in accident and emergency departments by reserving care home places and funding more hospital discharge packages.

policies.title: Proportional representation
policies.statement: Replace the first-past-the-post electoral system with proportional representation for electing MPs and councillors in England.

policies.title: Community policing guarantee
policies.statement: Restore community policing and guarantee that every burglary will be attended by police and properly investigated.

policies.title: Department for Growth
policies.statement: Break up the Treasury and create a new Department for Growth based in Birmingham to drive regional economic rebalancing.
